parseAudit.decision: The old 3-parse-error inventory is retained as historical evidence but does not define the canonical correctness cohort. The later canonical audit already records 6 parse errors plus 13 mixed-board exclusions and exactly 8,650 canonical cases.

deterministicBudgets.rule: Do not run formal determinism certification with absent, guessed, smoke-test, or CI-convenience budgets. Calibrate on the production-representative workload first. Watchdog hits must be zero during formal certification.

calibrationProtocol.initialOrder: cheap-to-expensive proxy; historical hotspot engineMs when known, then piece count; known extreme-tail orders forced last
calibrationProtocol.promotionRequirement: Version explicit positive integer production values with calibration evidence before formal certification.

correctnessPredicate.rule: Do not silently promote a plausible comparison rule into the historical/formal correctness contract.
